Name: (OBSOLETE IN 1.6) Slimmed-Down Slime Hutches
Author: sparrows413
Description:
[size=6]Obsolete in 1.6. [/size][size=4]Slime Hutches are now 7x4 by default, which is even smaller than this mod made them!
I am leaving this mod up just in case, but it is effectively useless now.[/size]

Inspired by Peasly's mod, Slim Hutch, I wanted to make a mod that would reduce the vertical footprint of the Slime Hutch without reducing its horizontal footprint. This means it is still compatible with any retextures, but makes it a lot easier to use in farm layouts. It also reduces the bizarre "dead space" that you end up with behind the building, where it seems like there shouldn't be any.

Already-built Slime Hutches should be affected by this once you install it, but I'm not so sure what'll happen if you uninstall it when a Slime Hutch is in a 4-tall space. My guess is that you would just not be able to put it back if you move it away and then change your mind, but I don't know for sure.
